The '''Chambers of Xeric''' is a [[raid]] located within a sprawling cave system beneath [[Mount Quidamortem]] in the [[Kebos Lowlands]]. It was the first raid introduced to ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''.

Long ago, [[Xeric]] and some of his followers travelled to the mountain after his exile from the kingdom of [[Great Kourend]]. The Chambers themselves and the now-ruined temple that sits above them were built by Xeric's personal artisan, [[Tekton]]. The experiments conducted within the Chambers resulted in, among many other things, the creation of the [[Muttadile]], an attempted coup by Xeric's [[Vasa Nistirio|High Priest]] (which resulted in Xeric ordering the destruction of the temple), and accidentally letting in [[Vespula|a powerful Abyssal creature]].

Even after Xeric took the power he sought within the Chambers, the caves still house the results of his many experiments, with [[Great Olm|the Guardian in the Deep]] Xeric himself fought against now protecting the weapons and armour he had created.

[[Ironman_Mode|Ironmen]] are eligible for rewards from the raid when completing it alongside other players. [[Group Ironman Mode|Group ironman players]] will lose their [[Group Ironman Mode#Prestige|prestige]] upon entering the raid with a player outside of their group.
